metaDescription: Check the status of your payment.

success.title: Payment successful!
success.description: Thank you for your purchase. Your credits are ready to use.

asyncDescription: Thank you for your purchase. Your payment is confirmed and your credits will arrive within moments — check your billing page.

processing.title: Payment processing
processing.description: Your payment is still being confirmed. This usually takes just a moment.
processing.refreshHint: Refresh this page in a few seconds to see the latest status.

failed.title: Payment failed
failed.description: This payment could not be completed and no credits were granted. If any funds were on hold, your payment provider will return them. You can try again from the pricing page.

invalid.title: Missing payment reference
invalid.description: We could not find a checkout session to verify. If you completed a payment, your credits will still be delivered automatically.

error.title: Verification failed
error.description: We could not verify this payment right now. If you were charged, your credits will still be delivered automatically — check your billing page shortly.
